thread.title: Apple plans some hiring reductions after selling fewer iPhones - Bloomberg

author: Reuters
title: Apple plans some hiring reductions after selling fewer iPhones - Bloomberg
text:
The logo of Apple is seen at a store in Zurich, Switzerland January 3, 2019. REUTERS/Arnd Wiegmann More (Reuters) - Apple Inc <AAPL.O> will cut back on hiring for some divisions after lower-than-expected iPhone sales and missing its revenue forecast for the holiday quarter, Bloomberg reported on Wednesday, citing sources familiar with the matter.
According to the report, Chief Executive Officer Tim Cook made the disclosure to employees earlier this month in a meeting the day after he penned a letter to investors about the company's recent struggles, particularly in China and said some divisions would reduce hiring.
Apple did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment.
(Reporting by Sonam Rai in Bengaluru; Editing by Maju Samuel)
